memory: I hold: PLL/distribution not at noise floor. SRD step: ~70 ps 20–80%, ~18 ps jitter measured on 50 GHz head. Trombone+varactor give 25–50 ps phase steps. Resistive damping reduced reflections −8 to −12 dB. An absorptive 50 Ω lowpass yielded ≲−30 dB at 500 ps but widened the edge to ≈140 ps and increased jitter. Conclusion revised: no single passive absorptive lowpass can both preserve ≤100 ps 20–80% edge and give −30 dB tail at 500 ps. Two viable strategies: fast matched path + digital deconvolution, or a targeted absorptive notch. Next: spectrum measurement.
openQuestion: Measure the SRD step amplitude spectrum 0.5–6 GHz: where does the tail energy peak (frequency) and how many dB below the edge harmonics?
